scopeWaiver.coherentObjective: One whole-app presentation-only migration to the exact existing Sign In-derived Chi'llywood visual system, with shared primitives and regression coverage preventing future visual drift.
scopeWaiver.reason: The Owner explicitly requires every appropriate user-facing route family and shared presentation primitive to converge in one permanent visual language; splitting the canonical token extraction from route-family adoption would preserve competing systems and make anti-drift enforcement internally inconsistent.
